title: CEO Mindset
author: requiem.moe
body: CEO... Just at the mere mention of the potentiality of me becoming a ceo towards those whom disliked, ridiculed, or otherwise belittled me, caused them to suddenly like me, be on my side, etc. I wonder if this is due to disrespect regarding my neetdom lifestyle and changing it, or maybe they see something I dont. Nonetheless I must push forward with my dreams, ideas, and projects. Whether I make it big or not is not the plan, I must get my vision out there. So many ideas... and I must breadcrumb those who would steal them. Sigh. Humans. Well USER, if I push through enough and become successful, I guess all the pain was worth it. 100k-50m doesn't sound bad for my ideas, though should I sell, and live life peacefully, or should I carve a name for myself into history? I may sell the lesser idea(s) so I can build the greater idea(s), honestly. Heres to potential success, USER!
